plugin.command_help: Open XcpCam: place camera nodes on a timeline, generate smooth camera motion, export .xcp / sync with Brio Vivacity timeline
topbar.file_tip: Import / export .xcp files and project embedding options
topbar.tab_timeline_tip: Multi-track camera timeline and playback transport controls
topbar.tab_graph_tip: Channel curves and timing curve editing
topbar.mini_on_auto_tip: Mini Timeline: On (auto-shown when main window is closed or collapsed; click to disable)
topbar.mini_off_tip: Enable fixed bottom Mini Timeline (adjust position & size in Settings → Mini Timeline)
topbar.not_gpose_warn: Not currently in GPose. Camera capture and live viewport features are unavailable.
preview.need_node: Requires at least one camera node.
preview.tip:
Places Brio's active free camera at the playhead to preview this frame in real time.
You can freely adjust angle and FoV while paused; playing or scrubbing re-syncs to the camera path.
preview.need_free_cam: Please switch to a Free Camera in Brio first.
preview.need_free_cam_live: Live Preview requires Brio's active camera to be a Free Camera.
mini.track_tip: Switch active track (scroll wheel with modifiers to scroll or zoom track lanes)
mini.frame_input_tip: Current frame (enter a frame number to jump)
mini.overlay_on_tip: Viewport Overlay: On (click to hide path & frustums)
mini.overlay_off_tip: Viewport Overlay: Off (click to show path & frustums)
toolbar.overlay_on_tip: Overlay: On (click to hide path & frustums)
toolbar.overlay_off_tip: Overlay: Off (click to show path & frustums)
toolbar.op_rotate_locked: Rotation is controlled by a tracking constraint
toolbar.op_scale_curve_only: Scale only applies to curve objects / control points
toolbar.curve_subdivide_tip: Subdivide segments between adjacent selected points
toolbar.key_capture_tip: Key: Add or update camera keyframe at playhead
toolbar.key_cut_tip: Cut: Hard cut from previous node to current view
sidebar.gizmo_rotate_locked: Selected node's rotation is controlled by a tracking constraint
sidebar.gizmo_target_tip: The gizmo automatically targets the last selected item: camera node or curve point / handle / object.
timeline.btn_insert_tip: Add a camera node at the playhead (replaces an existing node on that frame).
timeline.btn_append_tip: Append a new camera node after the last frame using the current gap ({0} frames).
timeline.btn_cut_tip: Capture current camera at the playhead with a hard cut from the previous node.
timeline.btn_sample_tip: Insert a camera node at the playhead sampled from the active track's motion.
timeline.btn_sample_disabled_tip: Playhead must be between two camera nodes on the active track.
timeline.length_anim_tip: Bound to Animation Scrubber: length matches animation duration and cannot be edited manually.
timeline.length_vivacity_tip: Timeline length (frames), synced two-way with Brio Vivacity timeline.
timeline.length_manual_tip: Timeline length (frames); cannot be shorter than the last camera node.
timeline.fps_brio_tip: FPS follows Brio Vivacity timeline automatically (can be disabled in Brio Sync).
timeline.fit_all_tip: Zoom timeline to fit all frames.
timeline.more_tip: Timeline options (append gap, tangent influence range, and tips)
timeline.append_gap_tip: Default frame offset when clicking Append or Duplicate.
timeline.tangent_range_tip: How many neighboring nodes automatically re-smooth tangents when editing pose or frame (0 = adjacent segments only; manual handles are preserved).
timeline.usage_hint: Drag node to retime · Drag ruler to scrub · Double-click to jump · ✂ Hard Cut
timeline.output_empty: Output: add at least one camera keyframe
timeline.point_loop_end_anchored_tip:
{0} · P{1} (cyclic return to start, 100%): Anchored to Timeline · Frame {2}
Drag to change loop-end frame, double-click to jump
timeline.point_loop_end_tip:
{0} · P{1}: Camera passes here again at Frame {2} (cyclic start is also at 100%)
Click to select, double-click to jump
timeline.point_tip:
{0} · P{1}: {2} · Frame {3} · Factor {4}%
{5}, double-click to jump.
timeline.point_drag_anchored: Drag to change anchor frame (camera passes this point on that exact frame)
timeline.point_drag_camera: Camera passes this point here; dragging switches the whole curve to Anchor to Timeline
timeline.node_tip:
{0} · Cam {1}: Frame {2} ({3}s){4}
Drag to retime · Double-click to jump
timeline.add_track_tip: Add a camera track at the top. Higher tracks take priority with automatic hard cuts at transitions.
timeline.track_active_tip: Active track: new keyframes are added here
timeline.track_select_tip: Click to set as active track
timeline.track_mute_tip: Mute: exclude this track from output
timeline.track_del_last_tip: At least one track must remain
inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty_no_nodes:
No camera nodes yet.
Frame your camera in GPose and click "+ Key".
inspector.empty_hint: Select a camera node or curve control point in the timeline or viewport to inspect.
inspector.group_center_tip: Drag the group center or in-game gizmo to translate/rotate the group; select a single node to edit FoV.
inspector.hold_tip: Hold frames: number of frames the camera stays still at this node.
inspector.cut_first_tip: The first node of a track cannot be a hard cut.
inspector.cut_tip: Hold previous node's pose until this frame, then cut instantly (Constant interpolation on all channels).
inspector.path_factor_anchored_tip: Follow Path (Timeline-anchored): editing factor moves the node's frame to match anchored timing.
inspector.path_factor_tip: Follow Path: node's distance progress along the curve (0–100%).
inspector.rot_locked_tip: Controlled by a tracking constraint (showing constrained angle). Edit in Constraints.
inspector.fov_locked_tip: Controlled by tracking constraint's Keep Framing; based on the track's first node FoV.
inspector.fov_base_tip: Keep Framing uses this first node's FoV and distance to target as reference.
inspector.recapture_tip: Replace this node with the current in-game camera
inspector.cp_unfollowed: This curve is not followed by any camera track and cannot be anchored.
inspector.cp_frame_anchored_tip: Timeline-anchored frame: the camera passes this point on this exact frame.
inspector.cp_frame_camera_tip: Frame when the camera passes this point. Editing switches the whole curve to Anchor to Timeline.
inspector.cp_jump_tip: Jump to this control point's frame
inspector.cp_loop_end_tip: Frame when a cyclic curve completes a loop and returns to P1 (100%).
inspector.cp_unvisited: Camera does not pass this control point (outside follow range or fewer than 2 nodes).
inspector.cps_unfollowed: This curve is not followed by any camera track.
anchor.scope_note: Anchoring applies to all points on the curve.
anchor.camera_tip:
Curve points follow the frames where the camera passes them and move with camera keyframes.
{0}
anchor.err_unfollowed: The selected curve is not followed by a camera track and cannot be anchored.
anchor.ok_timeline: Anchored "{0}" to Timeline (at current pass frames). {1}
anchor.err_no_visit: Camera does not pass any point on this curve; cannot anchor to timeline.
anchor.already_timeline: This curve is already anchored to Timeline.
anchor.already_camera: This curve is already anchored to Camera.
status.brio_pill_tip: Open Brio Sync window to configure sync source, XAT, and baking.
status.live_preview_active: Live Preview active: adjust the camera while paused to key or cut directly
status.ready_hint: Ready · Position your camera in GPose and click "+ Key"
status.no_gpose_target_tip: No GPose target selected. Nodes and curves use world space and remain editable; select a target before exporting .xcp or syncing XAT.
status.vivacity_fps_synced: Synced to Vivacity timeline {0} fps; camera timing converted by seconds.
status.anim_changed_retry: Target or animation just changed; please retry on the next frame.
status.source_unavailable: {0} is unavailable. Make sure you are in GPose with a target selected.
status.anim_freeze_failed: Failed to freeze target animation via Brio
status.anim_play_failed: Failed to play target animation via Brio
status.anim_pause_failed: Failed to pause target animation via Brio
status.left_gpose_rec_aborted: Left GPose; target trajectory recording aborted.
status.brio_stopped_anim: Brio stopped animation; camera timeline reset to frame 0.
status.anim_ended_frozen: Animation finished and frozen at end (loop disabled).
status.anim_ended_freeze_failed: Animation reached end, but could not freeze target; check Brio connection.
status.gizmo_limited: Gizmo limited: nodes must stay within {0}m of the target; sudden single-frame jumps are ignored.
status.group_limited: Some nodes were clamped within {0}m of the target.
status.pos_limited: Position clamped within {0}m of the target.
status.rec_stale_warning: {0} tracking constraint(s) have no baked trajectory or are stale; using live target pose for those (bake in Constraints).
status.rec_no_keys: Active track has no camera nodes to determine recording range.
status.rec_need_source: Recording requires an available {0}: enter GPose, connect Brio, and select a target (configure in Brio Sync).
status.rec_started: Recording target trajectory: frames {0}–{1}. Do not scrub the timeline…
status.rec_complete: Recorded trajectory: {0} constraint(s), {1} frames each (F{2}–F{3}). Used for export, XAT, and bake.
status.rec_incomplete: Recording did not cover F{0}–F{1} ({2} frames recorded). Check that the bound timeline plays to the end and the actor/bone exists.
status.node_move_blocked: Cannot move: would cross a neighboring node or collide with another progress key.
status.fps_sync_stopped: Stopped following Brio FPS; you can now edit FPS manually on the timeline.
status.cut_no_prev: No node before the playhead to cut from. Move the playhead after an existing node.
status.cut_added: Added hard cut at frame {0}: previous motion ends here and cuts instantly to the new camera.
status.sample_exists: Frame {0} already has node {1}; selected it.
status.sample_need_between: Place the playhead between two camera nodes; hold tails and empty regions cannot split a motion interval.
status.sample_invalid: Camera data at this frame is invalid; not created.
status.sample_added: Inserted sampled node at frame {0}; all 7 channel keys synced.
status.export_need_node: At least one camera node is required
status.export_cut_note: , {0} hard cut(s) (.xcp has ~1 frame transition per cut)
brio.source.vivacity_tip: Brio Vivacity timeline with two-way FPS and length sync.
brio.source.animation_tip: Selected character's animation scrubber; frame 0 corresponds to 0.00s.
brio.actor_tip:
Camera timeline follows this actor's animation progress.
When Brio's "Play / Freeze / Unfreeze / Stop All Animations" runs, this actor is used.
brio.sidebar_open_tip: Open standalone Brio Sync window (XAT sync & baking)
brio.opt_fps_tip: Automatically match Brio Vivacity FPS; node times are converted by seconds.
brio.opt_follow_tip: Follow playhead and live preview when {0} plays or scrubs.
brio.opt_len_tip: Keep timeline length matched with the bound time source.
brio.opt_freeze_tip: Automatically set animation speed to 0 when scrubbing to prevent it from continuing to play.
brio.xat_tip:
Automatically starts XAT playback when {0} reaches the start frame and stops on pause/stop.
Note: XAT cannot seek arbitrarily and requires a non-Free camera.
brio.xat_bind_tip: Bind current camera motion to {0} for XAT playback.
brio.xat_unbind_tip: Unbind XAT sync and restore original animation speed.
brio.xat_unbound_status: Unbound; restored animation speed prior to plugin control.
brio.bake_tip: Bake camera motion directly into a Brio Free Camera's Vivacity track with full scrubbing, looping, and instant cuts.
brio.bake_vivacity_only: Only supported for Vivacity Timeline. Currently bound to Animation Scrubber — use XAT Sync on the left.
brio.bake_no_free_cam: No Brio Free Camera found. Create a Free Camera in Brio's Camera window first.
brio.bake_base_fov_tip: Brio Free Camera FoV is an offset from the game's base FoV (default ~44.7°).
brio.bake_clear_existing: Overwrite existing keyframes on this camera track
brio.bake_fps_diff: FPS differs (XcpCam {0}fps / Brio {1}fps); converted by seconds when baking.
brio.bake_btn_tip: Bake composed camera motion into the selected Brio Free Camera track.
brio.bake_undo_tip: Restore the camera track before the last bake.
brio.bridge.no_timeline_svc: Brio loaded, but TimelineService was not found
brio.bridge.loop_unavailable: Brio timeline loop setting is unavailable
brio.sync.need_gpose_target: XAT sync requires a GPose target: .xcp stores target-relative poses.
brio.sync.bound: Bound: {0} frames ({1}s, {2} cut(s)), starts at {3} F{4}
brio.sync.replaced: XAT file in Brio was replaced; unbound
brio.sync.free_cam_warn: ⚠ Active camera is a Brio Free Camera; XAT playback will not apply. Switch to default/normal camera.
brio.bake.pitch_note: ; pitch exceeded ±86°, enabled Brio's Delimit Angle for this camera
xcp.import_modal.title: Import .xcp Preview
xcp.menu.import_tip: Import an .xcp with embedded project data or fit a regular XAT camera file.
xcp.menu.export_cut_tip:
.xcp is 30fps continuous frames; Brio interpolates adjacent frames (~1 frame transition per cut).
For instant cuts, use Brio Sync Bake or Live Preview.
xcp.menu.export_disabled_tip: At least one camera node is required to export.
xcp.menu.embed_project_tip: Appends the full timeline project to the end of .xcp so re-importing restores tracks, curves, and constraints losslessly (fully compatible with Brio).
xcp.import.project_details: Editable project · {0} fps · {1} frames · {2} track(s) · {3} node(s)
xcp.import.project_corrupt_warn: Project data could not be restored; you can reconstruct from playback frames. {0}
xcp.import.match_brio_len: Match Brio playback length (ignore last record)
xcp.import.too_many_frames: Single reconstruction supports up to {0} frames; please split first.
xcp.import.fit_btn_tip: Fit editable camera keyframes and channel curves using the current GPose target as origin.
xcp.import.world_note: Restored in original world coordinates; bone constraints will re-bind automatically in the current scene.
xcp.import.apply_btn_tip: Replace the current project with the imported result; undo restores the previous timeline.
xcp.fit.cuts_hint: Check frames with suspected camera jumps to insert a hard cut from the previous frame:
xcp.fit.details: Base {0} · {1} samples → {2} camera nodes / {3} intermediate keys (error: pos {4}m, angle {5}°, FoV {6}°)
xcp.import.vivacity_len_synced: Vivacity timeline length synced to {0} frames.
xcp.import.unresolved_constraints: Re-select actor or bone in Constraints: {0}
settings.general.title: General & Appearance
settings.general.language_tip: Follows the game client's language by default; changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
settings.general.theme_brio_tip: Uses Brio-style dark charcoal cards with purple-blue accents.
settings.general.theme_dalamud_tip: Uses your current Dalamud theme colors while keeping rounded cards and icon layouts.
settings.general.open_on_gpose_tip: When enabled, entering GPose auto-opens the main window and leaving GPose also closes auto-opened plugin windows. Manually opened windows are not closed automatically.
settings.general.show_toolbar: Show floating Viewport Toolbar in GPose
settings.general.show_toolbar_tip: Compact translucent floating toolbar modeled after Brio; can also be toggled from the main header.
settings.general.reset_sidebar_tip: Restore the right inspector sidebar to its default expanded width.
settings.mini.switch_tip:
Ultra-slim timeline fixed at the bottom center of the screen; cannot be moved or resized with the mouse to prevent accidental drags during GPose framing.
Continue scrubbing, playing, and adjusting keys after closing or collapsing the main window.
settings.mini.hide_when_expanded: Auto-hide Mini Timeline when main window is expanded
settings.mini.hide_when_expanded_tip: Enabled by default: shows Mini Timeline only when the main window is closed or collapsed; uncheck to keep it always visible in GPose.
settings.mini.expanded_notice: Main window is currently expanded; Mini Timeline will appear automatically when closed or collapsed.
settings.mini.geom_tip: Position and dimensions of the Mini Timeline can only be adjusted here and apply immediately.
settings.mini.offset_x_tip: Offset from horizontal screen center (0 = centered, negative = left, positive = right).
settings.mini.reset_tip: Restore to 900×115 px, horizontally centered, 20 px bottom margin, 0.88 opacity.
settings.overlay.title: Viewport Overlay
settings.overlay.tip: Controls camera path, frustums, and labels drawn in the game viewport.
settings.overlay.toggle_tip: Master toggle for drawing camera paths and frustums in-game.
settings.overlay.speed_colors_tip: Color path by movement speed: blue = slower, red = faster.
settings.range.title: Movement Limit
settings.range.tip:
Maximum distance of camera nodes from the current GPose target ({0}–{1} m, default {2} m); unlimited when no target is selected.
Nodes and curves are stored in world space and converted relative to target only on .xcp export / XAT sync.
Applies to gizmo, position inputs, and live preview; existing nodes are not moved automatically.
shortcut.hint: Use the dropdowns to change bindings; changes apply immediately and auto-save.
shortcut.reset_tip: Reset all keyboard shortcuts and mouse modifiers to defaults.
shortcut.conflict: This binding is already used by "{0}". Change or clear the existing binding first.
curve.tilt_tip: Roll along the curve; active only when Follow Curve is enabled in Constraints.
curve.radius_tip: Scales graph position offset when Use Radius is enabled in Constraints.
curve.handle_tip: Auto (yellow), Vector (green), Aligned (pink), Free (dark). Dragging Auto becomes Aligned; dragging Vector becomes Free.
curve.gizmo_limited: Gizmo limited: keep within {0}m of target; sudden single-frame jumps are ignored.
curve.status_added: Added "{0}" (3m in front of camera). Click control points or handles in-game to edit.
curve.status_extruded: Extruded and selected new control point(s).
curve.status_subdivided: Subdivided segment(s) between selected adjacent points.
curve.status_empty_deleted: Curve had no remaining points and was deleted.
curve.btn_add_tip: Create a new 3D path curve 3m in front of the current camera.
curve.axis_on_tip: Path Gizmo: On (click to hide control points & Bezier handles)
curve.axis_off_tip: Path Gizmo: Off (click to show control points & Bezier handles in-game)
curve.axis_panel_tip:
Displays control points, Bezier handles, and object pivot in the game viewport.
Points of a curve followed by the active track are always directly clickable.
curve.panel_help:
Curves and camera nodes use world coordinates.
Like Blender: Object Mode moves/rotates/scales the whole curve; Edit Mode edits control points and Bezier handles.
curve.node_path_tip: Default Bezier trajectory automatically generated from camera nodes.
curve.select_hint: Select a path on the left or click "+ Add Curve".
curve.mode.object_tip: Move / rotate / scale the whole curve in the viewport with the gizmo.
curve.mode.edit_tip: Select control points and Bezier handles in-game to extrude, subdivide, close, or reverse.
curve.cmd.extrude_tip: Extend a new control point from selected open spline endpoint(s).
curve.cmd.subdivide_tip: Insert midpoint(s) between selected adjacent control points.
curve.cmd.toggle_cyclic_tip: Close or open the spline(s) of selected points.
curve.cmd.switch_dir_tip: Reverse the direction of selected spline(s).
curve.node_path_help: Bezier path generated automatically from camera nodes. Enable "Path Gizmo" to drag round handles in-game to shape curvature.
curve.node_path_overridden_warn: Active track has a Follow Path constraint; the node path is not currently used for output.
curve.node_path_empty_hint: Enable "Path Gizmo" and click nodes or handles in the viewport to edit.
curve.node_path_handle_set: Updated path handle type for {0} node(s).
constraint.summary_none: No active constraints on this track
constraint.summary_follow_tip:
Follow Path ({0})
Click to open Constraints window
constraint.btn_add_tip: Add a tracking constraint (evaluated top-to-bottom, stackable with Follow Path).
constraint.status_added: Added {1} to "{0}": defaults to tracking the current GPose target's head.
constraint.type.damped_tip: Shortest rotation toward target while preserving node roll.
constraint.type.locked_tip: Rotates only around the locked axis (default Y for horizontal pan).
constraint.type.track_to_tip: Aims at target while keeping the Up axis aligned without roll.
constraint.panel_help:
Evaluated top-to-bottom like Blender Object Constraints: Follow Path drives position, then tracking constraints drive rotation (and optional FoV).
Channels driven by constraints cannot be manually edited on nodes.
constraint.empty_hint: No tracking constraints. Click "+ Add Constraint" above to aim the camera at a character bone.
constraint.fp.title: Follow Path
constraint.fp.tip:
Camera moves along the selected 3D curve while camera nodes control path factor and timing.
Rotation and FoV remain controlled by camera nodes or tracking constraints.
constraint.fp.removed: Removed Follow Path constraint; nodes kept their current positions.
constraint.fp.set: "{0}" now follows "{1}": first node 0%, last 100%, others distributed by frame.
constraint.fp.no_curves_hint: Add a curve in the Paths window first
constraint.fp.follow_curve_tip: Camera rotates along path tangent; node rotation acts as relative offset, and curve tilt drives roll.
constraint.fp.use_radius_tip: Scale graph position offsets by control point radius.
constraint.fp.reset_tip: Clear manual path factors and restore 0% start, 100% end, distributed evenly by time.
constraint.fp.reset_status: Reset node path factors to even time distribution.
constraint.fp.anchor_camera_tip: Curve points move with the frames where the camera passes them (default). Applies to the whole curve.
constraint.fp.anchor_timeline_tip:
Pins all control points of the curve to timeline frames so the camera passes each point on its exact anchor frame.
{0}
constraint.fp.anchor_ok_timeline: Curve anchored to timeline at current pass frames. {0}
constraint.fp.anchor_err_no_visit: Camera does not pass any point on this curve; cannot anchor to timeline.
constraint.fp.anchor_ok_camera: Curve switched back to Anchor to Camera.
constraint.tc.unbaked_tip: Not baked yet (live tracking in preview)
constraint.tc.toggle_tip: Enable or disable this tracking constraint
constraint.tc.influence_tip: 0 = off, 1 = fully aimed at target, intermediate values blend between unconstrained and constrained rotation.
constraint.tc.keep_framing_tip: Automatically adjusts FoV by target distance to preserve the first node's framing scale (dolly zoom).
constraint.tc.target_offset_tip: World-space offset added to the target bone position.
constraint.tc.screen_offset_tip: Framing offset in screen space: 0,0 = center, ±100% = edge (e.g., X = -33% for left rule-of-thirds).
constraint.tc.track_axis_tip: Camera axis aimed at the target (game camera looks along -Z; normally keep -Z).
constraint.tc.lock_axis_tip: Only rotate around this camera axis (Y = horizontal pan, X = vertical tilt).
constraint.tc.actor_tip: GPose character to track (including Brio-spawned actors).
constraint.tc.bone_unavailable_hint: Actor unavailable; showing common bones only.
constraint.rec.unbaked: Not baked (live preview works; bake required for export)
constraint.rec.stale_range: Stale: covers F{0}–F{1}, track is F{2}–F{3}
constraint.rec.btn_one_tip: Play the bound timeline and record this constraint's world bone trajectory for export/XAT/bake.
constraint.rec.btn_all_tip: Play from F{0} to F{1} and record all enabled constraints' bone trajectories for .xcp / XAT / bake.
constraint.rec.footer_hint: Track range F{0}–F{1} · Bake before exporting if the bone moves with animation
graph.no_keys_hint: No camera keyframes on this track yet. Add keys in the Timeline tab first.
graph.status_anchors_synced: Speed curve applied; curve point timeline positions synced to pass frames.
graph.mode.channel_tip: Directly edit channel values, speed curves, and node frames; timing curves are kept locked.
graph.mode.timing_tip: Shape overall easing for Position / Rotation / FoV across the shot; channel curves are kept intact when switching.
graph.mode_help: Channel Curves and Timing Curves are mutually exclusive; inactive mode data is preserved and can be switched anytime.
graph.badge_anchored_tip: Curve is anchored to timeline: editing speed updates curve point pass frames; dragging curve points on timeline retimes anchors.
graph.single_node_empty: This shot has only one node; no timing curves available.
graph.driven_simple_tip: Tracking constraints determine final orientation (and FoV); timing here only affects stored node values.
graph.driven_channel_tip: Channels driven by tracking constraints cannot edit values or handles; you can still drag horizontally to retime nodes.
graph.vis_tip: Show or hide this timing channel
graph.unlink_tip: Split Position / Rotation / FoV into three independent timing curves.
graph.link_src_tip: Reference channel whose timing is used when linking.
graph.link_tip: Copy the selected source channel's timing to the other two channels and re-link (undoable).
graph.auto_smooth_tip: Restore automatic time-based smoothing across the shot (ease in/out at ends, smooth through middle nodes).
graph.status_smoothed: Restored automatic time smoothing for the shot.
graph.fit_simple_tip: Zoom canvas to fit the entire shot timing curve.
graph.interp_out_tip: Applies to the outgoing segment from a key to the next key
graph.scope_batch_tip: Batch apply scope (locked channels are skipped)
graph.hmode_both_tip: Bezier handle mode applies to both sides of the key
graph.insert_node_tip: Sample and insert a camera node at the current playhead frame.
graph.insert_node_locked: Inserting a node affects all channels; unlock all channels first.
graph.move_rejected: Move rejected: node order, range, or progress key collision.
graph.delete_locked: Deleting a node affects all channels; unlock all channels first.
graph.driven_handle_locked: This channel is driven by a tracking constraint; handles cannot be edited, but keys can still be dragged horizontally to retime.
graph.handle_edit_failed: Cannot edit handle: channel locked or invalid value.
graph.sg_insert_node_tip: Sample and insert a camera node at the cursor frame.
graph.sg_insert_ch_key_tip: Insert intermediate keys on visible unlocked channels only.
graph.sg_fit_all_tip: Zoom view to show the entire shot.
graph.sg_fit_sel_tip: Zoom view to focus on selected keys.
graph.sg_normalize_tip: Normalize visible channels with different units to [-1, 1] for comparison.
graph.sg_help_base: X-axis is frame. Path Progress is normalized length (0–1), Position Offsets are world meters, Rotation and FoV are degrees.
graph.sg_help_follow: Track follows a curve: drag Path Progress vertically to reposition nodes along the curve, and adjust handles for speed.
graph.sg_help_nodepath: Shape the node path in the game viewport; Path Progress values come from node positions, while handles adjust speed.
graph.sg_add_locked: Adding a node affects all channels; unlock all channels first.
graph.sg_add_ok: Selected camera node at frame {0}; all channel keys synced.
graph.sg_insert_ch_none: No visible unlocked channels available to insert at the cursor frame.
graph.sg_del_locked: Deleting a node affects all channels; unlock all channels first.
graph.sg_del_ok: Deleted {0} camera node(s) and {1} intermediate key(s).
graph.sg_preset_none: Preset: no editable keys in the selected scope.
graph.sg_preset_ok: Applied preset to {0} key(s); Auto handles only consider contiguous selected nodes.
graph.sg_move_invalid: Cannot move: duplicate parameter, locked channel, or outside shot bounds.
graph.sg_move_dup: Cannot move: duplicate target path parameter.
graph.sg_move_mixed: Drag camera nodes and independent channel keys separately in time.
graph.sg_move_retime_blocked: Node retime rejected: collision or crossed neighbor.
graph.sg_fit_sel_none: No visible selected keys to frame.
graph.sg_locked: Channel curves are locked; switch editor mode first.
overlay.tooltip_object_mode: Object Mode: move / rotate / scale the whole curve with the gizmo
overlay.tooltip_pick_follow_point:
{0} · P{1} ({2})
Click to select curve point
capture.anim.no_actor: Bound actor not found (no GPose target or actor is no longer in the scene)
capture.anim.not_playing: Target is not currently playing an animation
capture.bone.no_model: Character has no model or skeleton
capture.bone.head: Head
